caption: A person mops up a puddle of water on a concrete floor, the water disappearing as the mop passes.
first_prompt: A single realistic photograph of the initial scene immediately BEFORE the following action begins: A person mops up a puddle of water on a concrete floor, the water disappearing as the mop passes. Show the participants and objects in their starting positions, with enough room for the action. Show one moment only, not a montage, not the completed outcome. No text or diagrams.

clauses.text: The mop must be dipped into the puddle and moved across the wet floor to absorb the water.
The water level must visibly decrease as the mop is dragged across the surface.
The mop must continue moving until the puddle is fully absorbed and the floor appears dry.
The mop must be lifted and moved away from the area after the water is gone.
